notes.title: The minigame mania will arrive tomorrow! 🤘🎡
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186270/6bcc9aa23b99b13fae954d5a93dd42fef7030c14.gif[/img]

Being our first videogame, the reviews that you communicate to us are very important for us. That's why we decided to make these free monthly updates.

You will be able to see the evolution of Aimtropolis first hand, 5 mini-games every month... until we reach 50.

And as promised, the new round of mini-games arrives tomorrow!

5 new mini-games will be ready to play.
